pages.text: They had run out of milk for the morning dough. The white milk cart was at the market, ringing its bell. Jingle, jingle!
Coco took an empty bottle. "I'll get the milk."
Mrs. Magpie looked down from the roof. "A white cart? I can see everything from up here!"
"That white thing over there!" It was a white quilt on a clothesline.
"Then that white thing!" A white cat on a wall yawned.
"It's white over there too!" It was a cart loaded with sacks of flour.
From above, everything white seemed to look like a milk cart. Coco's legs were getting tired.
Coco stood still and listened. Jingle, jingle. There was a bell.
It was the milk cart's bell. Coco walked toward the sound.
The bottle was filled with milk. Mrs. Magpie called from the roof. "There it is! That's where I told you to go!"
